_comment: Heuristic first-party code patterns that make a vulnerable package reachable. A match means 'look closer', no match means 'not obviously used', never proof either way. Extend freely.

handlebars.note: Template-injection CVEs need an attacker-controlled template or AST passed to compile/precompile; pre-compiled static templates are not exposed.

lodash.note: Prototype pollution needs attacker-controlled keys in merge/set paths; template() needs attacker-controlled template or options.

minimist.note: Prototype pollution when parsing attacker-controlled argv/strings.

xml2js.note: Prototype pollution when parsing untrusted XML.

jsonwebtoken.note: Algorithm-confusion and key-type issues depend on how verify() is called.

axios.note: SSRF / credential leakage depends on attacker-influenced URLs, redirects or headers.

express.note: Check the specific advisory: many affect only particular middleware or query parsing.

body-parser.note: DoS issues apply to services accepting untrusted request bodies.

qs.note: Prototype pollution / DoS when parsing attacker-controlled query strings.

node-forge.note: Signature verification issues matter only if you verify certs/signatures with forge.

path-to-regexp.note: ReDoS applies when route patterns are attacker-controlled.

semver.note: ReDoS applies when untrusted version strings are parsed.

tar.note: Path traversal when extracting untrusted archives.

@sap/cds.note: CAP runtime: always treat as reachable; follow the SAP security note.

org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core.note: JNDI/lookup issues depend on attacker-controlled data reaching log messages or patterns.

com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-datab.note: Deserialization gadget CVEs need polymorphic typing on untrusted JSON; DoS CVEs need untrusted JSON.

org.yaml:snakeyaml.note: Unsafe constructors on untrusted YAML are the exposure; in Spring Boot only application.yaml is usually parsed.

com.thoughtworks.xstream:xstream.note: Needs untrusted XML and a permissive security framework.

org.apache.commons:commons-text.note: Needs attacker-controlled input into substitutors with interpolation enabled.

com.h2database:h2.note: Console/JNDI issues apply when the H2 console or untrusted JDBC URLs are exposed. Often test/dev scope only.

org.apache.tomcat.embed:tomcat-embed-cor.note: Embedded Tomcat is on the request path of every Spring Boot web app: treat as reachable.

org.springframework:spring-web.note: Check advisory preconditions (e.g. specific handlers or Java version).

org.postgresql:postgresql.note: JDBC URL / connection-property issues need attacker-influenced connection strings.

com.sap.cds:cds-services-api.note: CAP Java runtime: always reachable; follow the SAP security note.
